verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official, well-specified programmatic surface for OneDrive through Microsoft Graph, a 'single API' covering driveItem addressing, upload sessions, delta/change tracking, change notifications, search, sharing links and versions. However, none of the cited docs mention an official SDK or client library, and probes for an OpenAPI spec at learn.microsoft.com returned 404. The story is delivered only as raw REST API docs, not SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of official language SDKs/client libraries, SDK install/usage docs, a machine-readable API spec for codegen, and independent hands-on corroboration of building with an SDK.
